name: New AI Product From Idea
summary: Walkthrough for turning an idea or brief into a controlled AI-assisted product foundation.
use_when: a founder idea or greenfield initiative needs a practical walkthrough
do_not_use_when: a real repository already exists and hardening is the urgent problem
cli: python3 -m vcp_cli spec questions --idea "describe the product idea" --json
stop_conditions: do not skip backlog and memory setup for meaningful work
